reason: E2 stopped at seq5 frame137 because a spatial-memory mutation did not change final logits, although independent restoration and no-op checks passed. Native SAM2 absence gating can hide a changed readout; the exact failure is replayed prospectively for diagnosis.
scope: Instrumentation positive control only. No checkpoint, prompt, sample, intervention, scientific endpoint, split, statistical test or evidence bar changes.
control: Perturb only an independent bank copy with a fixed nonuniform -10 to +10 offset across memory channels. Capture the native memory-attention output using a temporary forward hook. Require the readout to change, then restore from a separate saved copy and require both readout and final prediction bit-identical to baseline.
additional_requirements: Detached, empty-mask, zero-bias, value-identity and memory-identity no-ops must be bit-identical at the readout as well as final masks. Full-token exclusion must equal frame exclusion at both locations. Attention reconstruction remains <1e-5.
diagnostics: Keep final-prediction mutation sensitivity as a diagnostic, not a universal requirement. Record object scores and constant-mask logits. The targeted seq5:137 replay additionally repeats the old uniform +10 mutation to test the proposed absence-gating explanation.
provenance: Version2 checks require all new flags; historical version1 evidence keeps its original requirements. Do not relabel a failed historical run as passed. Keep completed units and rerun the failed and remaining units in a new folder. CPU tests are not GPU validation.
